findings.claim: The new wrapper around reportDiagnostic silently drops every diagnostic whose location is not an in-source location in the current compilation. That includes diagnostics created with a null or Location.None location. This covers more than the metadata-symbol crash. Insecure-configuration diagnostics could be suppressed, but only if they are reported without a source location; the diff doesn't show such a diagnostic, so this is unverified.

receipt_plan.detail: Read every Diagnostic.Create call in TypeCollector that passes a null or Location.None location (for example the MsgPack003/004/005 sites). Confirm none of them protects against an unsafe deserialization configuration. A test could assert that a source-declared type missing [Key] still reports MsgPack004.
